description: React component for displaying restaurant listings, including search, map view, cart management, and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: navigateClearCart
methods.description: Clears the cart and navigates to the selected restaurant page.

methods.name: checkCart
methods.description: Checks if the cart belongs to the selected restaurant and prompts for clearing if necessary.

methods.name: toggleClearCart
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the clear cart modal.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a message to the user.

methods.name: searchRestaurants
methods.description: Filters restaurants based on search text.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Component rendering the map view with a button to show the map.
